title: Core agents, middleware, signals, traces
routing: Is this about foundry-core's agent building blocks: BaseAgent and its Executor, the Harness (the flow pipeline to the executor, every message traced), thread.dispatch / thread.fan(), toolUseLoop, resolveAgentOpts; the MiddlewareChain around dispatch (use / useWhen, the thread's flow and configured-sources middleware, DispatchContext); the side channels (SignalBus, EventStream, InterventionLog, ActionQueue, BoundedSet); or Trace spans and trace records (serializeTrace into the journal, prepareCheckpointImport)? Plain jobs: make an agent that does the work and returns the full result, send a message straight to a named agent, wrap or retry every dispatch, stop agents once the budget is spent, broadcast a correction, stream events to the UI, record and replay how one message travelled.
